# rar-models

<!-- Generated by tools/config-reference.py from libs/rar-model/src/main/resources/META-INF/oidf-settings/rar-models.json. Do not edit: change the catalogue, then run python3 tools/config-reference.py. -->

The settings of the `rar-models` component of `libs/rar-model`, read by package `com.pingidentity.ps.oidf.rar.model`: generated from its catalogue, [rar-models.json](../../libs/rar-model/src/main/resources/META-INF/oidf-settings/rar-models.json), by `tools/config-reference.py`, and checked in CI. [How to read a row](README.md#reading-a-row).

Families: `OIDF_RAR_MODELS_`. A name under one of these that no catalogue declares is an unknown key.

Under the production profile a violation by one of these settings refuses `ATTESTATION_AUTH` ([components](../development/settings-catalogue.md#components)).

| Setting | Default | What it does | When it's wrong | Profile | Security |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `OIDF_RAR_MODELS_FILE` | Unset; a file path | A file holding the RAR models document (more types, and fields added to the built-in ones), read once per classloader as UTF-8: the one source every classloader reads - the token-endpoint filter, the attester, the OGNL issuance criterion and the RAR plugin each load it once and log its SHA-256 fingerprint - and never a plugin field; the attestation context carries the filter's fingerprint as rar_models_fingerprint, and the plugin refuses a request whose fingerprint is not its own, which keeps the classloaders in step; unset, with OIDF_RAR_MODELS unset too, the built-in models only | **Doesn't start**: A value that is not a path, a missing or unreadable file, a document the schema refuses, or both OIDF_RAR_MODELS_FILE and OIDF_RAR_MODELS set: MODEL_INVALID, logged naming the setting; the token-endpoint filter and the attester's issuance servlet are FAILED_CONFIG at deploy, and the RAR plugin and the issuance criterion refuse every request they are asked about | Any | Yes |
| `OIDF_RAR_MODELS` | Unset; a JSON object | The RAR models document inline, in place of OIDF_RAR_MODELS_FILE (setting both is refused), blank counting as unset: the one source every classloader reads - the token-endpoint filter, the attester, the OGNL issuance criterion and the RAR plugin each load it once and log its SHA-256 fingerprint - and never a plugin field; the attestation context carries the filter's fingerprint as rar_models_fingerprint, and the plugin refuses a request whose fingerprint is not its own, which keeps the classloaders in step | **Doesn't start**: Not a JSON object (from 0.6.0, read through this catalogue), a document the schema refuses, or both OIDF_RAR_MODELS_FILE and OIDF_RAR_MODELS set: MODEL_INVALID, logged naming the setting; the token-endpoint filter and the attester's issuance servlet are FAILED_CONFIG at deploy, and the RAR plugin and the issuance criterion refuse every request they are asked about | Any | Yes |
